evidence_digest: Cause isolated and scope sufficient. job-object.ts launches the target with bInheritHandles=true but never sets STARTF_USESTDHANDLES or separate target handles, so target stdin/stdout/stderr alias helper control streams; target bytes can consume control frames, spoof responses, or cause helper loss. tracked-process.ts skips managed output and records helper exit as target exit. send writes before registering a paired waiter, while separate resolver/failure queues leave stale entries. The helper reports terminated immediately after TerminateJobObject without waiting on the held target handle. Remediation isolates target I/O, pairs bounded request state atomically, waits on the target handle, and separates helper/target lifecycle proof.
